_comment: ARC-AGI-1 bands (8 blocks/segment) in the TRM ARC-AGI-1 recipe (SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels, 4 GPUs): global batch 768, 1000 augmented versions per task (identifiers task * 1001 + v), lr 1e-4 after 2000 warmup steps, puzzle_emb_lr 1e-2, weight decay 0.1 (both), AdamATan2 betas 0.9/0.95, EMA 0.999, 100,000 epochs, ACT with halt_max_steps = loops = 16 and exploration 0.1. Data: data/arc1_trm.npz = TRM's split (training + evaluation + ConceptARC from kaggle/combined; demonstrations of every task plus the test pairs of the training and concept tasks, 3,988 pairs per epoch, so 100,000 epochs = 519,200 steps; test = 419 evaluation test pairs, identity version, no voting). Evaluation every 500 epochs (2,596 steps; TRM every 10,000). grad_accum is chosen by scripts/arc1_trm.sh bench (largest per-GPU micro-batch that fits). Checkpoints every 10,000 steps without carry, last 2 kept.
